text: For Plotinus, time is generated by the Soul — it is 'the life of the Soul in a movement of passage from one way of life to another' — rather than being an independent feature of the mindless physical world.
explanation: This is true: it is Plotinus's central definition from Enneads III.7.11. Time is the form of Soul's discursive, sequential activity, not a container the world possesses independently of mind; the physical cosmos is temporal precisely because it is animated by the cosmic Soul, which unfolds in succession what Intellect grasps all at once.
